error[VIBE2701]: `ref="nope"` has no matching `useTemplateRef('nope')`.
  --> template/ref-errors/input.vibe:2:8
2 |   <div ref="nope"></div>
  |        ^^^^^^^^^^
fix: Declare it in `<script setup lang="ts">`, as in `const nope = useTemplateRef('nope')`.
fix: Fix the spelling of the ref name.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2701

error[VIBE2702]: A bound `:ref` must be a function or a member path that holds one.
  --> template/ref-errors/input.vibe:3:14
3 |   <div :ref="count++"></div>
  |              ^^^^^^^
fix: Pass a function, as in `:ref="(el) => (input = el)"`.
fix: Use a string ref with `useTemplateRef`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2702

error[VIBE2703]: `v-html` needs a value.
  --> template/ref-errors/input.vibe:4:8
4 |   <div v-html></div>
  |        ^^^^^^
fix: Write the value, as in `v-html="content"`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2703

error[VIBE2704]: `v-text` replaces the content of the element, which must be empty.
  --> template/ref-errors/input.vibe:5:8
5 |   <div v-text="text">x</div>
  |        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
fix: Remove the children of the element.
fix: Remove `v-text` and render the value as a child.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2704

error[VIBE2705]: `v-show` needs a condition.
  --> template/ref-errors/input.vibe:6:8
6 |   <div v-show></div>
  |        ^^^^^^
fix: Write the condition, as in `v-show="open"`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2705

error[VIBE2706]: `v-show` can only be used on an element, not on `<Item>`.
  --> template/ref-errors/input.vibe:7:9
7 |   <Item v-show="text" />
  |         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
fix: Wrap the content in an element and put `v-show` on it.
fix: Use `v-if` instead of `v-show`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2706
